extName.description: Extension name. Keep it in English: it is the product name.

extDescription.message: Opens the Following tab on X (Twitter) automatically, sorted by Recent or Popular. No tracking, no data collection.
extDescription.description: Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions description. At most 132 characters.

versionLabel.description: $1 is the version number, such as 2.1.0.

enabledLabel.description: On/off switch for the whole extension.

enabledDescription.message: Open your chosen tab every time you visit the X home page.

defaultTabLabel.description: Label of the list of home tabs to open by default.

defaultTabDescription.message: Tabs are matched by their position, so this works in every language.

tabOption.description: One entry in the tab list. $1 is the position (1, 2, 3…), $2 the tab name.

tabForYou.description: Name of X's first home tab, shown until the real names are known.

tabFollowing.description: Name of X's second home tab, shown until the real names are known.

tabPinned.description: Placeholder name for a pinned list or community tab.

tabMissing.message: $1. Not on your home page right now
tabMissing.description: A saved tab position that X does not show at the moment. $1 is the position.

tabsUnknownHint.message: Visit x.com/home once to list your pinned lists and communities here.
tabsUnknownHint.description: Shown when the extension has not seen the home tabs yet.

sortLabel.description: Label of the sort order list for the Following timeline.

sortDescription.message: How the Following timeline is sorted when it opens.

sortRecent.description: Sort option matching X's Recent order.

sortPopular.description: Sort option matching X's Popular order.

sortKeep.description: Sort option that does not change X's current order.

sortOnlyFollowing.message: Only used when the default tab is Following.
sortOnlyFollowing.description: Shown when another default tab is chosen.

openSettings.description: Button in the popup that opens the settings page.

statusReset.description: Confirmation after restoring the default settings.

statusError.description: Shown when saving a setting fails.

optionsSubtitle.message: Choose which tab the X home page opens on.

resetButton.description: Button that restores the default settings.

aboutTitle.description: Heading above short notes on how the extension behaves.

aboutManual.message: If you switch tabs yourself, your choice stays until you reload the page.

aboutNoFlash.message: While the tab switches, the timeline is hidden for a moment, so you never see the wrong feed.

aboutPrivate.message: Your settings stay in your browser and sync through Chrome if sync is on. Tab names stay on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere.

reportProblem.description: Link to open a GitHub issue.

disclaimer.message: Not affiliated with or endorsed by X Corp.
